reason: OneCrew 2.3-A1 moved the project filter of context retrieval into SQL too (context._rows), so removing the Python line alone no longer leaks and the T51b E5 counterexample would prove nothing. The mutant now removes BOTH layers (unfiltered_retrieve + unfiltered_rows) with the same expected leak, and a new test shows each layer holds alone. The E5/E12 checks are unchanged; stricter.
